title: baseline: BotUsernameCheck/CreateBotState/CreateSubmission match answers by a generation counter, not a RequestId
trigger: Type a bot username, edit it before the check answers
effect: Answer dropped by counter compare; works today but is the counter shape

title: known: in-chat search matches pages by ChatSearchState::generation counter (plus pending.chat_id)
trigger: Search, change query, old page answers
effect: Old answer dropped by counter; set_sender/set_media do not bump generation themselves

title: BotEditTexts keeps asked:(RequestId,RequestId) beside BotText::Loading(id), and saved:u8 counter
trigger: Open bot edit; ids duplicated in two places
effect: No bug today; two copies of the same request ids

title: ChatListState::archive_settings_open bool mirrors the ArchiveSettings dialog box that open_box(DialogKind::ArchiveSettings) already owns
trigger: Open Archive settings, switch account (closer resets flag by hand in settings_state.rs), or close via box host only
effect: No bug today (closers exist); open stage lives in two places, session flag + box host, set by hand from settings_ui.rs
fix: drop the flag; derive open from the box host / OnScreen

title: handled_add_requests is only cleared by 'process all', so a chat that asks again after an approve/reject is filtered out of the requests page
trigger: Reject a chat's add request, the chat asks again, reopen the community requests list
effect: The new request never shows in the list this session (apply_add_chat_requests_page skips handled chat ids)
fix: key the handled mark by request/page answer, or drop the mark when the server returns the chat again

title: A failed SearchDiskPausedDownloads resets DiskSearch to NotAsked, so every healthy disk reading re-sends it
trigger: Saved disk pauses exist, TDLib refuses searchFileDownloads (error); the periodic disk poll runs on a healthy disk
effect: The 'once per session' search is re-sent at the disk-poll cadence for as long as the error lasts
fix: DiskSearch::Failed{at} (retry with backoff) or Done on a definite error

title: baseline: message calendar matched by calendar_generation counter in SearchPurpose::GetChatMessageCalendar{generation}
trigger: Open the calendar, change month/chat while a page is out
effect: Stale pages dropped by counter compare; works today

title: baseline: BotLookup matches its three Fetch parts by a generation counter, not the RequestIds the Fetches hold
trigger: Type in the business-bot search box while a part is out
effect: A stale part is dropped by counter compare; each Fetch already holds its RequestId
fix: drop generation; the three Fetch requests are the guard

title: baseline: blocked-senders pages matched by blocked_generation counter (SettingsPurpose::GetBlockedSenders{generation})
trigger: Block/unblock while a blocked-list page is out
effect: Old page dropped by counter compare
fix: Paged blocked list holding the page RequestId

title: data_storage_dirty bool is a 'needs a disk write' mark the reducer sets and the driver takes; a failed write drops the mark
trigger: Presets seed lands on a read-only folder
effect: Failure is said once on the page and the mark is gone; the settings stay unsaved until the next change

title: baseline: SettingsState::pending_attention bool (allow-listed one-shot dock-bounce event)
effect: No bug; one-shot bool drained by take

title: StickersManager::open bool is a box-open flag in the account Session (same shape as archive_settings_open)
trigger: Open the stickers manager, switch account and back
effect: A closer (settings_state.rs) resets it by hand; open stage lives in the Session beside the box host
fix: derive open from the box host / OnScreen

title: baseline: Fetch::Loading.request is an Option (None between begin() and sent()), so the in-flight variant can hold no request
trigger: Any caller that does begin() and then fails to send before sent()
effect: Loading{request:None} matches no answer and nothing clears it but cancel()/fail(); callers seen send first, then begin()+sent() together
fix: Loading{request: RequestId} built by one begin_with(request) call

title: baseline: StoryFetch::Asked holds no RequestId (unkeyed)
trigger: A story fetch answered or lost
effect: Cleared by story_arrived/failed/forget_outcomes by story key; no request match

title: baseline: CalendarPaging::Loading holds no request; stale pages dropped by HistoryCalendar::generation counter
trigger: Open the date calendar, change media filter/month while a page is out
effect: Counter compare drops the old page; Loading carries no RequestId

title: PollOptionMenu.properties answered by (chat, message, option_key) from the purpose, not by a RequestId held in the stage
trigger: Open the option menu, close, reopen the same option while the first getPollOptionProperties is out
effect: The older answer fills the newer menu (same data, so harmless today)

title: MenuActions caches Know::Failed per message until 16 other entries evict it, so a failed getMessageProperties is never retried for that message
trigger: Right-click a message while offline/erroring, then again after reconnecting
effect: Menu keeps the fail-closed actions (no revoke) until the entry is evicted or forgotten
fix: Failed{at} with backoff, or drop on reconnect

title: add_members_failed and member_action_error are answered per chat id, not per request
trigger: Add members / change a member's status in a chat, two actions overlap
effect: A late error line can land on the newer action's box
